after.label: Confirmed-service APDU retries
after.description: Literature proposal or actual device/PICS configuration; saving does not execute BACnet or establish capacity.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Unsigned integer confirmed-service retries; literature proposal 3, actual no-retry devices may use zero. Generic retry probability is distinct.

after.description: Literature proposal or actual device/PICS configuration; saving does not execute BACnet or establish capacity.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual boolean device capability, initially unknown, selects the applicable timeout default.

after.label: Confirmed-service APDU timeout
after.description: Literature default: 3000 ms if modifiable, otherwise 60000 ms. Device property remains unknown until this condition is known. Must be nonzero when retries are nonzero.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Unsigned integer ms. Conditional literature defaults 3000 if writable, 60000 otherwise; neither is a universal required operating value. Positive if retries positive. UI condition required before proposing; confirmed operating value preserved.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual normal/BBMD/foreign-device BVLC role, initially unknown; topology determines applicability.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual assigned identity 0..4194302; wildcard/unconfigured 4194303 is excluded from assigned instances.

after.label: Foreign-device registration TTL (0 = deregister)

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual accepted APDU length 50..1476 for this IP baseline, unknown. Device property may be 256; six values in the confirmed-request header encoding must not be mistaken for all device property values.
